entities.summary: Lieutenant Colonel Eric Marshall was a British Army doctor and Antarctic explorer with the Nimrod Expedition led by Ernest Shackleton in 1907–09, and was one of the party of four men who reached Furthest South at 88°23′S 162°00′E on 9 January 1909.
